Four preserved task-owned plain evidence blobs also exceed 262,144 bytes (3,456,356; 12,503,732; 3,456,356; 12,480,477). They are added relative to the protected base and therefore are not the policy's untouched protected-base historical exclusion. The result honestly remains BLOCKED; seventeen successful named command executions do not satisfy the mandatory normal gate or task DoD.
